messages.content: Please scan the living_room for smart devices, then check the status of the living room light for device_id light_living and set its target_state to on at target_brightness 75 with target_color warm_white. After that, use lock_id lock_main to change the lock_state to lock with PIN 1234. Then create a document titled “Trip Summary” using the result, and send me an app notification on channel app for user_id user_001 with medium priority and the tags finance and travel.
